description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The DACH Enterprise team is at the forefront of driving revenue and growth across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. As trusted business partners, we work with the most ambitious market leaders and high-growth innovators — DeepL, Refurbed, N26 to Nestlé — helping them build the financial infrastructure that powers their next stage of growth. We're known for our product expertise, rigorous thinking, and user-first approach to problem-solving.

Stripe's financial infrastructure is the engine that unlocks new revenue streams, automates complex local compliance, and drives global expansion for the region's most prominent businesses. This is a pivotal moment for Stripe in DACH — the market opportunity is significant, and our team serves as a critical source of user feedback and market intelligence, with direct influence on the product roadmap and growth strategy. We're a diverse, international team that values collaboration and curiosity, and we're looking for someone who's eager to share knowledge and keep learning.

What you’ll do

As an Account Executive, Enterprise Hunter at Stripe, you'll own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and closing to managing existing relationships and identifying new opportunities to expand Stripe's footprint within existing accounts. Specifically, we're looking for someone who can execute on long-term sales strategies, engage with internal and external stakeholders, align on technical and business requirements with product teams, build value in competitive situations, lead commercial negotiations, and close deals. You will be responsible for defining and executing multi-year account strategies, generating your own targeted outbound opportunities, and orchestrating complex, multi-threaded sales cycles—from discovery and solution design through commercial negotiation, onboarding of new products, activation, and expansion. You are an energetic and highly organized self-starter who understands how to navigate complex organizations, engage the right decision-makers and influencers, and succinctly communicate Stripe’s differentiated value—both business and technical—for each customer.

Responsibilities

  • Own a named account list and develop account plans for winning new business with digital native and enterprise companies
  • Build, prioritize, and manage a robust, multi-threaded enterprise sales pipeline, including multi-quarter forecasting and account planning.
  • Own the full sales cycle end to end—from executive engagement and lead generation through scoping, solution design, commercial negotiation, closing, onboarding, activation, and early expansion.
  • Proactively generate your own pipeline through targeted outreach (e.g. cold calling, blitzing, research, networking, events, partners) and by driving a clear territory and account strategy.
  • Effectively manage and advance leads qualified by inbound and outbound sales development representatives, ensuring smooth hand-offs and high conversion into late-stage opportunities.
  • Ensure every potential and existing Stripe user has an excellent, high-touch experience at every interaction, regardless of deal size, seniority, or stage of the relationship.
  • Identify and deeply understand users’ business models, technical environments, and pain points in order to shape and propose impactful Stripe solutions and multi-year roadmaps.
  • Orchestrate and coordinate cross-functional Stripe teams (e.g. Solutions Engineering, Product, Legal, Risk, Operations, Marketing, Partnerships, Leadership) to align on strategy and ensure internal resources are set up for user success and long-term growth.

Minimum requirements

  • 6+ years of sales experience, preferably selling a highly technical product to enterprise customers, with a track record of top performance 
  • Ability to understand technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple products
  • Ability to develop and execute account plans spanning multiple business units across complex organizations
  • A knack for working well with a wide range of people, both internally and externally
  • Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders
  • Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and in German
  • Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment • Strong interest in technology and a deep understanding of the space

Preferred requirements

  • Strong interest and knowledge in technology, the payments landscape, and related products, with the ability to advise customers strategically on payments, monetization, and platform architecture.
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills, including experience crafting and delivering executive presentations, proposals, and commercial narratives.
  • Ability to think and operate strategically (e.g. building multi-year account plans, portfolio strategies) and connect this thinking back into concrete operational execution across internal teams and customer stakeholders.

description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. We offer a highly competitive compensation package with On-Target Earnings (OTE) of €80,000 onwards designed to reward high performance and results. This includes a strong base salary complemented by an uncapped commission structure, meaning there is no limit to what you can earn — your success directly drives your income. Top performers have the opportunity to significantly exceed OTE, supported by a transparent, performance-driven bonus plan that truly rewards achievement. Building on this performance-driven culture, not every candidate ticks every box — and that’s why we value individuals with a growth mindset who bring potential, initiative, and a willingness to learn. description: Meer leren. Meer doen. Meer carrière. Dat is stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer. Eindelijk kun je de theorie in de praktijk toepassen: jij hebt er zin in, en wij ook! Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam krijg jij de kans om midden in de actie te staan. Geen koffie halen of papierwerk, jij duikt samen met onze projectleider in de praktijk van energietransitie en energie-armoede. Of het nu gaat om het uitvoeren van inspecties of meedenken over interventies: jij maakt impact. Dit wordt jouw stage Wil jij meedenken over een maatschappelijk vraagstuk dat steeds urgenter wordt? Tijdens deze stage duik je in het thema energiearmoede: wat is het precies, waar speelt het en wat betekent dit voor ons als organisatie? Je werkt op het snijvlak van sociaal en technisch en helpt ons om richting te bepalen: hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? Je werkt mee binnen één van onze teams en wordt begeleid door een ervaren collega. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen én om echt impact te maken. Op dit moment hebben wij één afstudeerstageplek rondom het thema energietransitie en energie-armoede Wat ga je doen? Je gaat onderzoeken wat energiearmoede inhoudt en hoe dit zich uit in de praktijk, met name in stedelijke gebieden zoals Amsterdam waar veel (sociale) huurwoningen zijn. Je houdt je bezig met: Het in kaart brengen van wat energiearmoede betekent; Inzicht krijgen in waar het speelt en welke doelgroepen geraakt worden; Gesprekken voeren met corporaties en marktpartijen (interviews, ophalen van ervaringen en data); Onderzoeken welke oplossingen er zijn, zoals passief bouwen, minder installaties of slimme energieoplossingen; Vertalen van jouw inzichten naar een duidelijke visie: waar moeten wij ons op richten en hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? Het gaat hierbij niet om de techniek alleen, maar juist om de combinatie van sociale impact, marktontwikkelingen en strategie. Dit is jouw team Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam is een ontwikkelende bouwer met zo'n 220 enthousiaste collega’s. Wij zijn onderdeel van de Divisie Bouw en Vastgoed en herkenbaar in groen en geel. Onze ambitie is groot en met veel enthousiasme ontwikkelen en bouwen we gezonde en fijne leefomgevingen, waar mensen zich thuis voelen. Benieuwd waar wij ons mee bezig houden? Bekijk hier een paar van onze huidige projecten: Projecten Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam Dit bieden wij jou Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uren per week; Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatieven; Tijd voor je schoolopdrachten/examens; De beste collega’s om het vak van te leren en zij zorgen voor een ongekende goede werksfeer; Een familiebedrijf waarin we voor elkaar klaarstaan! Dit breng je mee Je doet een hbo- of wo-studie in de richting van bouwkunde, built environment, duurzaamheid, technische bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare studie; Nieuwsgierigheid naar veiligheid in de praktijk, vooral in de bouwsector; Niet bang om je handen uit de mouwen te steken; Proactief, sociaal en je werkt graag samen, maar weet ook zelfstandig je weg te vinden; Beschikbaar vanaf februari 2027 voor minimaal 4 dagen per week. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijnvisie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Meer weten? Neem contact op met onze Campus recruiter! description: About the role Every number that reaches our leadership team, our board, and our auditors has to be right the first time — and that is where you come in. As a Business Operations & Data Specialist focused on Finance at Destinus, you are the bridge between the owners of our financial data, the CFO, and the wider finance team and the data in our lakehouse. You own how finance data is defined, where it comes from, how it is produced, and how it reaches the people who make decisions with it. This is as much an operations role as a reporting one. You will translate what finance needs to know into what the data platform has to deliver, working with our Data Engineers on the finance data in the lakehouse and building the dashboards the CFO and the finance team rely on. You will also improve the processes and systems that create the numbers in the first place, automate the manual work that eats the month, and make our finance data understandable to everyone who needs it, including our AI assistants. At Destinus, we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing — bringing speed, precision, and innovation to every process that powers our advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). We are a fast-growing international group operating across several European entities, and the standards we hold our financial data to are rising just as quickly. Join us in building a finance reporting foundation that is accurate, traceable, and ready for any question asked of it. What You'll Do Be the go-to contact between the business owners of finance data — the CFO, accounts payable and receivable, and treasury — and our lakehouse: turn their questions into clear data requirements, and the data back into answers they can act on. Build and maintain Power BI dashboards covering cash flow, receipts and collections, payables, and spend across the group, built on certified lakehouse data. Partner with our Data Engineers on the curated (gold) layer for finance: specify the tables, fields, and business rules — entities, currencies, financial dimensions, intercompany — and validate the result against the ledger before anyone relies on it. Prepare and quality-check entity-level data extractions from our lakehouse and ERP in support of the external audit, and keep audit requests tracked from request to delivery. Define and document finance KPI definitions in our KPI catalog — formulas, inclusions, exclusions, owners, and sources — to a standard that withstands external review. Describe our finance data in plain business language — what each field means, who owns it, and how sensitive it is — for our shared meanings layer, so that colleagues and our AI assistants can use it correctly without having to ask you first. Automate what is manual today: turn recurring spreadsheet work, audit packs, and month-end routines into repeatable processes that largely run themselves. Improve the finance processes and system configuration that create the data, working with the finance team and our ERP specialists, so that issues are fixed at source rather than corrected every month. Help the finance team get more from the tools through training and self-service, so they can answer their own questions. Requirements What You’ll Need Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Controlling, Economics, or a related field. A genuine finance background is essential — experience in external or internal audit, controlling, financial reporting, or FP&A. This is not a data role with finance on the side; you need to understand the accounting behind the figures. Confident with general ledger and subledger structures, trial balances, accounts payable and accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, intercompany transactions, and the principles of IFRS. Strong expertise in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, dashboard design, troubleshooting), complemented by advanced Excel skills. Comfortable querying data with SQL and working in a lakehouse or data warehouse environment; experience with Microsoft Fabric or a medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture is a plus. You will not build the pipelines — you need to know what to ask for and how to check what comes back. Able to explain data to finance colleagues and accounting logic to technical ones — and to get both sides to agree on one definition. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance is a strong advantage — the general ledger, accounts payable and accounts receivable modules, and the data structures underneath them. We run on D365, and someone who already knows it will be effective months earlier. An interest in improving how the system is configured and used matters as much as knowing where to click. A track record of simplifying or automating a process, not only reporting on it. Experience supporting an external audit, or working in a multi-entity, multi-currency international group, is a strong advantage. Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus. Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment is preferred. Who You Are You are precise, and you are curious about where a number came from before you are comfortable reporting it — whether that means reading the ledger or querying the lakehouse. You know the difference between a figure that looks right and a figure that can be traced back to its source, and you care about the second one. You are not content to rebuild the same report every month. When something is manual, repetitive, or fragile, your instinct is to go upstream and fix it rather than absorb it. You enjoy working with finance colleagues who ask hard questions, and you would rather be challenged on a detail than have it slip through. Above all, you want your work to be relied on, by the CFO, by the board, and by anyone who audits it. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role We're expanding our protein expression into mammalian cell culture, for example in CHO and HEK cells. Our mammalian expression volume is growing fast. We're looking for a Cell Culture Engineer who has spent years growing and transfecting mammalian cells and knows what to do when a run goes wrong. You'll work alongside our production and mammalian cell teams as a hands-on expert in the cell culture lab. You'll keep cultures healthy and on schedule, run transfections and expressions, and be the person the team turns to when yields drop or cells misbehave. This is a hands-on role, not a management role. What You'll Do Run mammalian expression. Maintain, expand, and passage cell lines, and run transfections and expressions on a production schedule. Troubleshoot. When viability, growth, or yield falls off, find the cause and fix it. Own the cell bank. Thaw, freeze, and track cell stocks, and protect the lines from contamination and drift. Optimize conditions. Test culture and transfection conditions, and turn what works into the standard protocol. Scale with automation. Work with our automation team to move cell handling onto liquid handlers as volume grows. Hand off clean material. Deliver harvests ready for purification and downstream assays. Keep the lab running. Look after incubators, biosafety cabinets, and cell counters, and keep the BSL-2 space organized and compliant. Write SOPs and train. Document protocols that others can follow, and train the team on aseptic technique and our cell culture workflows. What We're Looking For Extensive hands-on experience with common mammalian model cell lines, for example CHO and HEK, including transfection and expression. BSc / MSc in biotechnology, cell biology, or a relevant field. A troubleshooting track record. You've rescued failing cultures and expressions and can explain what went wrong and why. Flawless aseptic technique and experience working under BSL-2 conditions. Experience with high-throughput formats: multi-well plates and many conditions in parallel, not only flasks. Experience with liquid handlers is a plus. Experience with antibody or Fc-fusion production is a plus. Organized and precise. You track every stock, passage, and transfection, and you follow protocols exactly. You use AI tools effectively and with discernment. We use them across the company and expect you to check, edit, and stand behind what they produce, not pass along unreviewed output. Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift. Cells don't keep office hours, so you plan around them. Application deadline We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description:
About Workato

Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com.

Why join us?

Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles. We are driven by innovation and looking for team players who want to actively build our company. 

But, we also believe in balancing productivity with self-care. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives. 

If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!

Also, feel free to check out why:

  • Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”
  • Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world
  • Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America
  • Quartz ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers

Responsibilities

We are seeking a visionary Regional Chief Strategic Architect to serve as Workato's technical authority and strategic advisor to our most critical prospects, customers, and the broader market within their assigned region. The Chief Strategic Architect operates at the nexus of technical credibility, executive influence, and market thought leadership, acting as the external-facing voice of Workato's innovation and technical vision.

This is not a sales role. It is a strategic, hybrid operator-advisor-influencer position. Chief Strategic Architects act as extensions of the executive team in the field, elevating conversations with senior leaders and positioning Workato as the essential platform for enterprise integration, AI orchestration, and intelligent automation.

This role is accountable for building technical trust across the customer lifecycle - from initial engagement through strategic expansion - while simultaneously shaping how the market understands enterprise integration, AI orchestration, and intelligent automation. The Chief Strategic Architect influences deal outcomes, product direction, and industry perception, ensuring Workato is recognized as the definitive leader in Enterprise Orchestration.

Learn & Align (Days 0-30)

  • Deep immersion into Workato's AI vision, product roadmap, and GTM strategy

  • Shadow at least 10 executive customer conversations

  • Develop initial point of view for engagement with CIO/CTO/CDO personas

Engage & Formulate (Days 30-60)

  • Lead first strategic engagements with enterprise accounts

  • Co-develop executive playbooks with Sales and Product teams

  • Establish feedback loops with Product and Engineering teams

Influence & Scale (Days 60-90)

  • Cultivate trusted relationships with C-level executives in 5+ strategic accounts

  • Co-create first AI-driven integration use cases with customers

  • Establish thought leadership presence through content and speaking opportunities

Technical Trust & Executive Relationships

  • Engage directly with C-level executives (CIOs, CTOs, Chief Data Officers, Chief AI Officers) at enterprise accounts to shape integration strategies that solve complex business challenges

  • Serve as trusted technical advisor throughout the customer lifecycle - from initial engagement through expansion - providing strategic guidance rooted in real-world operator experience

  • Build lasting peer-to-peer relationships that position you as the go-to expert on enterprise integration, AI orchestration, and automation at scale

  • Act as technical closer in competitive deals, articulating why Workato's architecture differentiates us from competitors like MuleSoft and Boomi

  • Influence enterprise architecture decisions and multi-year technology strategies at the executive level

AI, Agentic Automation & Enterprise MCP Strategy

  • Shape and guide customers' AI and agentic automation journeys, leveraging Workato's AI capabilities and ecosystem

  • Partner with customer executives to define enterprise MCP (Model Context Protocol) strategies including context management, secure AI orchestration, and governance

  • Translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, scalable enterprise use cases that drive measurable business outcomes

  • Position Workato as the integration and orchestration backbone for enterprise AI transformation

Domain Expertise & Thought Leadership

  • Lead "Art of the Possible" workshops that fundamentally shift how customers think about enterprise integration and intelligent automation

  • Shape industry narratives and best practices that establish Workato as the category leader

Deal Acceleration & Commercial Impact

  • Partner with Account Executives and Sales Leadership on account strategy, competitive positioning, and C-level engagement tactics

  • Articulate compelling ROI narratives and business case frameworks that accelerate buying decisions

  • Demonstrate measurable impact on win rates, deal size, and sales cycle length in strategic opportunities

Strategic Advisory & Technical Leadership

  • Guide prospects and customers through Enterprise Orchestration vision and roadmap development

  • Develop prioritization frameworks for integration, automation, and AI use cases

  • Lead technology evaluation and vendor selection processes with enterprise customers

  • Design governance, scalability, and enterprise operating models for automation initiatives

Product Influence & Market Intelligence

  • Act as the voice of the customer to Product and Engineering teams, channeling field insights into actionable roadmap input

  • Identify capability gaps, competitive threats, and market opportunities based on executive-level customer conversations

  • Develop and refine competitive positioning, objection handling, and differentiation strategies

  • Define reusable patterns, reference architectures, and technical frameworks that accelerate customer success

  • Influence industry analysts and thought leaders to strengthen Workato's market position

Internal Enablement & Team Development

  • Educate and enable Sales Engineers, Account Executives, and Customer Success teams on complex technical capabilities and emerging trends

  • Develop strategic frameworks, competitive positioning, and executive engagement playbooks for enterprise accounts

  • Mentor technical team members, helping them develop deeper domain expertise and executive engagement skills

  • Create scalable technical enablement content and programs that amplify your expertise across the field organization

  • Drive customer reference creation and participation in case studies, speaking opportunities, and advisory boards

Requirements

Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

  • 20+ years of technology transformation experience, including integration, middleware, or API management platforms

description: About the role As Data Platform Manager you will own Destinus's company data platform. Built on Microsoft Fabric, it brings together data from our different systems, and it serves the reporting and data agents that production, supply chain, program management, and finance work from every week. You will own its architecture: how OneLake and our lakehouses are structured, how data lands in them from the systems we run, and how it holds up as more of the business comes to depend on it. You will lead a small team of data engineers — setting direction, reviewing their work, growing them — and you will keep building yourself. You are also the person who makes our AI ambitions possible: the foundation behind our data agents and our Company Brain is yours to design and deliver. At Destinus we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing, building advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) across three European plants. The data you will work with is physical — parts, build progress, shortages, non-conformances — and the questions asked of it get harder each year as we grow. If you want a platform you can still shape rather than one already set in concrete, this is a good moment to arrive. What You'll Do Own the architecture of our Microsoft Fabric estate end to end — OneLake, our lakehouses and their bronze, silver, and gold layers, workspace and domain structure, naming conventions, and the standards that keep it coherent as it grows. Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of data engineers: set priorities, review code, raise the technical bar, and develop the people. Stay hands-on. You will build pipelines, notebooks, and Delta tables yourself, not only direct others who do. Own the integrations that land data in OneLake from our source systems — ERP, HR, shopfloor, quality, and the business applications that come after them — choosing sensibly between Data Factory pipelines, dataflows, shortcuts, and mirroring for each source. Own the gold layer and the semantic models built on it, so that Power BI reads from one governed source rather than from copies scattered around the business. Work closely with our Business Operations & Data Specialists, who represent the business owners of each domain: turn their requirements into the right gold tables, agree definitions with them, and give them a platform they can query, validate, and explain to the business with confidence. Own lineage across the estate: know what feeds what, be able to prove it to an auditor, and make dependencies visible rather than tribal knowledge. Build the data foundation for our AI programme — the lakehouse structures, pipelines, and knowledge graph behind our Fabric data agents and our Company Brain — and deliver it to a standard that can be trusted with a real question. Design and maintain the OneLake security and access model together with your team: workspace roles, access groups, and the controls that decide who sees what in the lake. Keep the platform reliable, observable, and cost-aware: monitoring, alerting, recovery, and disciplined use of our Fabric capacity — including knowing what a runaway notebook costs us. Requirements What You’ll Need Requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field. 5-8 years of data engineering experience, including real ownership of a lakehouse architecture rather than only delivering against someone else's. Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience is strongly preferred — OneLake, lakehouses, Delta tables, the SQL analytics endpoint, Data Factory pipelines, Spark notebooks, and semantic models in Direct Lake mode. If your depth is in Azure Synapse, Databricks, or Data Lake Storage Gen2 and you have since moved onto Fabric in earnest, we will take that seriously. Strong command of the medallion pattern and of Delta Lake in practice: partitioning, schema evolution, table maintenance, and why a gold table behaves the way it does. Genuinely hands-on. Strong SQL, solid PySpark, and comfort building and orchestrating pipelines yourself. This is not a role that stops at diagrams. Practical understanding of Fabric capacity: how workloads consume it, how to spot what is burning it, and how to keep the platform inside its envelope. Experience leading engineers — formally, or as a technical lead who set direction and mentored others. A first step into people management is welcome if the technical leadership is already there. Proven integration experience with ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 / MSD, as well as APIs, flat-file landings, and change data capture from operational databases. Solid data modelling skills, including dimensional modelling and an understanding of how a semantic layer serves Power BI. Working knowledge of lineage, data governance, and access control in a cloud platform; exposure to Microsoft Purview is a plus. Interest or experience in the data foundations behind AI assistants — retrieval, knowledge graphs, and preparing data so that an agent can answer with it. Aerospace or another regulated industry is an advantage; so is experience in a start-up or scale-up. Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus. Who You Are You are an architect who never stops building. You have strong opinions about how a platform should be structured, and you earn the right to them by being in the code. You would rather make a design decision explicit and documented than let it live in one person's head. You care more about reliability than novelty. You know that the measure of a data platform is whether people trust the numbers that come out of it on a Monday morning, not how modern the stack looks on a slide. When something breaks, you want to know why it was possible, not just how to patch it. You enjoy growing engineers, and you understand that leading a small team means doing the work alongside them. Above all, you want to build something durable — a foundation that holds while the company scales on top of it. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Our Developer Ecosystem organisation shapes how developers and the AI agents working for them build on the Databricks Data and AI Platform, from within the product to the tools they already use.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our declarative deployment framework, which turns data and AI projects into versioned, reviewable, repeatable software. It is one product with two entry points. Third-party developers use our open-source CLI from their IDEs, terminals, and CI/CD systems. First-party, they author, deploy and inspect the same projects inside the Databricks workspace. In both, AI agents increasingly do the work: coding agents drive the CLI, and our in-product AI assistant authors and deploys projects alongside the developer. Thousands of organisations run their CI/CD on it, and it is one of the fastest-growing parts of the platform.

The team owns the deployment engine and CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and the metadata service and deployment history that record every deployment. The hard problems are real infrastructure-as-code problems: reconciling declared and live state, making plans safe for humans and agents to approve, keeping visual authoring and code in sync, and shipping weekly releases that remain backwards-compatible for our largest customers.

The impact you will have:

  • Lead and grow the team: Manage a team of senior engineers across three closely connected areas (the deployment engine and open-source CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and deployment history and metadata), working with strong tech leads. Hire, coach and promote, and grow engineers into tech leads.

description:
Agile Robots SE is an innovative company with a clear mission: bringing intelligent robotic solutions to our customers. We combine the latest technology in the field of AI with powerful robotic systems — from industrial robot arms and mobile manipulators to humanoids — to solve tasks that classical automation cannot address.

At the heart of our offering is a versatile software platform for orchestrating complex robotic systems. It allows efficient customization for specific customer requirements: configuring systems, developing reusable skills, parameterizing processes, and executing tasks reliably in production. Learned models — from perception to end-to-end policies — are a core part of this platform.

Our solutions are deployed with international customers across a wide range of industries. Seamless integration and scalable deployment are at the core of our mission.

We are looking for a passionate Forward Deployed AI Engineer to bring state-of-the-art robot learning and computer vision models into real production environments. In this role, you will train, fine-tune, and deploy AI models directly on customer robots — from Vision-Language-Action models and diffusion policies to perception and grasp generation networks. You will become a trusted technical partner, turning customer challenges into robust, data-driven robotics applications. The role is based in Munich, Germany.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy, fine-tune, and evaluate AI models on real robotic systems at customer sites — including Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, diffusion policies, and other end-to-end learned policies
  • Adapt and train perception models for robotic applications, e.g. object detection, segmentation, and pose estimation based on YOLO, SAM, vision transformers, and self-supervised backbones such as DINOv2
  • Integrate and tune grasp generation models (e.g., GraspNet, Dex-Net, Contact-GraspNet) for bin picking and manipulation tasks
  • Build data pipelines for customer deployments: demonstration and teleoperation recording, dataset curation, annotation, training runs, and systematic evaluation of model performance
  • Bring models into production: optimize inference, deploy on edge and embedded hardware, and integrate models into our robotic software platform
  • Work closely with customers to understand technical requirements and translate them into robust, AI-driven robotics applications
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve model, software, and system integration issues both remotely and on-site
  • Travel to international customer sites for workshops, deployments, training, and technical support (up to 40% travel)

Essential Skills

  • Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience
  • Minimum of four years of professional experience in machine learning, AI for robotics, or computer vision
  • Hands-on experience working with real robots — robot arms, mobile manipulators, grippers, cameras, and sensors — not only in simulation
  • Proven experience with end-to-end learned models for robotics (e.g., VLAs, diffusion policies, imitation or reinforcement learning policies), covering training, fine-tuning, and deployment
  • Strong programming skills in both Python and C++
  • Solid command of machine learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and the full model lifecycle: data curation, training, evaluation, and deployment
  • Experience with modern computer vision models such as YOLO, SAM, vision transformers, and self-supervised backbones (e.g., DINOv2, CLIP)
  • Experience with learned grasp generation for manipulation (e.g., GraspNet, Dex-Net, or comparable approaches)
  • Good understanding of robot (inverse) kinematics, coordinate transformations, and hand-eye calibration
  • Experience working in Linux environments
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt quickly in customer environments
  • Fluency in English

Beneficial Skills

  • Experience with large-scale demonstration data collection, teleoperation setups, and sim-to-real transfer
  • Experience with robot learning simulation frameworks (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac Sim/Lab, MuJoCo, Gazebo)
  • Good understanding of classical computer vision (e.g., OpenCV, PCL, camera calibration, point cloud processing)
  • Experience optimizing inference (e.g., TensorRT, ONNX, quantization) and deploying on NVIDIA embedded platforms (e.g., Jetson Orin, AGX, Xavier)
  • Experience with MLOps tooling: experiment tracking, dataset versioning, and continuous training or evaluation pipelines
  • Publications or open-source contributions in robot learning, manipulation, or computer vision
  • Familiarity with industrial automation environments (e.g., PLCs, EtherCAT, OPC UA)

 

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio; together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.

Find out more at: https://www.agile-robots.com/en/

description:
Graduate Programme — Babyzone

  • Are you torn between the excitement of start-ups and the stability of corporate life? 
  • Are you keen to continue learning and developing skills whilst experiencing how to build businesses?
  • Are you looking for a role that will offer the opportunity to experience first-hand how a tech company is built, and be supported while taking ownership of work that matters? 

If this sounds like you and you are up for the challenge, we would love to hear from you!

We are looking to hire high-energy, entrepreneurial and value-adding graduate talent to join Blenheim Chalcot in a role dedicated entirely to Babyzone, one of the social-impact organisations supported by BC.

ABOUT US

At Blenheim Chalcot, we invest more than just funds. We invest our knowledge and experience, our ideas and infrastructure. Our ventures are at the forefront of a multitude of industries being disrupted by digital including FinTech, EdTech, GovTech, Media, Sport, Charity and more. We are highly entrepreneurial and seek opportunities where digital technologies can disrupt major markets - ventures we have built include ClearScore, Salary Finance, Modulr and the Rajasthan Royals cricket team.

Many of the companies within the portfolio have materialised from ideas conceived and launched by us, and we have over 4,000 employees to support their growth and development. Our assets under management stand at more than £1.8bn and total portfolio revenue is over £500 million.

We work closely with investment and strategic partners ranging from Paypal, FIS, L&G, Tencent, Experian, Google, WorldPay, Imperial College and some of the leading venture capital and private equity companies internationally.

Our central team, Venture Builder Services (VBS), exists to support our ventures to be successful quickly, sustainably and with access to the best practice tools, solutions, and expertise. We provide a range of services to help new business get off the ground, including technology, growth (marketing and sales), talent, finance, legal and tax.

 

 IMPACT BEYOND PROFIT

15% of our partnerships and ventures are charities. These include the British Asian Trust, Babyzone and Onside Youth Zones. In the same way that we support our ventures, our Partners provide direct hands-on support to these charities by being active board members and offering expert advice.

ABOUT BABYZONE

Babyzone is an innovative and fast-growing UK early childhood charity. It runs free, open-access community hubs for families with children aged 0-5 in areas of high deprivation, bringing together services, programmes and partners to improve outcomes for young children and their families.

 THE GRADUATE OPPORTUNITY

Joining Blenheim Chalcot as a Graduate, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced and progressive environment while working exclusively with Babyzone. You will be embedded within the Babyzone team and contribute to meaningful projects that support the charity's growth, operations and impact, while benefiting from Blenheim Chalcot's learning, development and employee benefits.

For you as a graduate, this opportunity involves:

  • Dedicated to Babyzone – although you will be employed by Blenheim Chalcot, your role will sit fully within Babyzone. Your day-to-day work, projects and objectives will be focused entirely on supporting Babyzone and its mission, giving you the opportunity to build deep experience within a fast-growing, mission-led organisation.
  • Training & Development – we pride ourselves on having an intentional and continuous learning and development culture at Blenheim Chalcot. You will have access to BC learning and development opportunities designed to strengthen your core professional, commercial and leadership skills, while applying that learning directly to your work at Babyzone. You will learn by doing, taking on real responsibility and developing quickly within the Babyzone team.
  • Early Careers Development – as a BC graduate, you will have access to structured development opportunities designed for those early in their careers. These will support your professional growth while your role itself remains fully dedicated to Babyzone.
  • Graduate Community – you will be part of the wider BC graduate community, with access to relevant learning sessions, networking opportunities and socials. This community is intended to support your development and connection with fellow graduates; your substantive role and day-to-day responsibilities will remain entirely within Babyzone.
  • Accountability – you will be given meaningful responsibility from the outset and supported to take ownership of work that matters. Rather than rotating between businesses, you will build continuity and depth within Babyzone, seeing the direct impact of your work on the organisation and the families and communities it serves.

 

ARE YOU BC? 

We are not expecting you to have worked in start-ups before or to have studied a tech related degree. For us, it is about hiring the right person and their potential, not just their experience. As such, we are looking for graduates from any discipline – different areas of expertise are great for new perspectives. 

We look for some key fundamentals in people when hiring into the BC Group. We look for people who are:

  • Curious – people in BC are inquisitive, they want to understand ‘why’ and consider if there is a better approach rather than take on the ‘it’s how we’ve always done it’ perspective. Given our ethos is all about disrupting industries with new methods and products, curiosity is at the heart of what we do.
  • ‘Doers’ – surprisingly, this is not a given in a lot of working environments; we are a community of pro-active self-starters. We will provide full support to our graduates, though we do look for proactive people who can use their initiative and drive on a daily basis. Working in an environment where everyone has this trait is incredibly refreshing and we strive to maintain it.
  • Flexible Mindset – working in a growth business environment is ambiguous, diverse and, at times, chaotic by definition. Being adaptable and recognising the importance of flexibility to add value in a constantly evolving company is vital for us.
  • Enthusiasm – you do not need to be a ‘techy’ at heart to work in our environment. We are looking for people who are enthusiastic about what digitalisation is doing to industries and a drive to work in a pioneering sector which represents that drive. A desire for doing new and challenging things makes coming into work a whole lot more fun.
  • Humble & Sociable – building a tech start-up is never easy. As such, we have a ‘no-ego’ policy and seek out people who bring energy to a team, not drain it. We have a down-to-earth and personable culture; we solve complex problems but do not take ourselves too seriously and look to have fun whilst doing so.

If you see yourself in this and would like to work with similarly minded people, we would love to hear from you!

 

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU AS A BC EMPLOYEE:

  • Be part of the UK’s leading digital venture builder and have the opportunity to be a part of and learn from the incredible talent in BC
  • Be exposed to the right mix of challenges and learning and development opportunities while building deep, hands-on experience within Babyzone
  • A fun and open, if a little cricket obsessed, atmosphere
  • Discretionary bonus
  • 25 days of paid holidays + your birthday off
  • Life Assurance, Pension Scheme, Cycle to Work Scheme
  • Flexible Benefits including Private Medical and Dental, Gym Subsidiaries

 

APPLICATION & PROCESS

If you are keen to apply, please submit your CV and a member of our Talent Team will contact you with next steps. We have a rigorous recruitment process, which we use for all our roles to ensure we attract the very best talent. 

We have a three-stage process that will consist of the following:

Stage 1: Telephone interview with a member of the BC Talent team

 

Stage 2: Virtual assessment day, consisting of both individual and group activities

 

Stage 3: Final interviews with Blenheim Chalcot and Babyzone at Scale Space, White City

 

*Please note the timeframes provided above are subject to change, which we will communicate throughout the process*

Blenheim Chalcot is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Diversity is one of our core values, thus making it core to our business. We strive to maximise the diversity of our workforce and welcome applications from everyone. We encourage diversity through perspective, background, identity, and thought whilst also fostering an environment where everyone can express themselves regardless of your race, religion, sex, gender, colour, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We are committed to continuing to nurture an inclusive environment and building a diverse workforce.

description:
We're looking for an ML Data & Platform Engineer to own the infrastructure that powers our speech AI models: the pipelines that source and prepare training data, and the platform that trains, evaluates, and serves them in production. Speech AI has a data problem most ML teams don't, and you'll be at the centre of solving it, working as part of our ML team to remove friction across the entire lifecycle and get better models into production faster.

This is a broad, cross-functional role suited to someone who enjoys working across the full stack: data infrastructure, distributed systems, and production ML, and who takes ownership of problems end to end rather than waiting to be told what to fix.

What you'll do

  • Designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, validating, and storing large datasets used to train our models
  • Developing and maintaining web scraping and data acquisition solutions to keep training datasets fresh, high-quality, and available at scale
  • Building and operating the infrastructure that lets the ML team deploy and evaluate new models quickly, and that serves models efficiently and reliably in production
  • Optimising infrastructure for both iteration speed and production reliability, including GPU utilisation, job scheduling, and training efficiency
  • Implementing observability (monitoring, logging, alerting) across data pipelines and ML systems to catch issues early and keep things running smoothly
  • Troubleshooting complex issues across distributed systems, spanning data infrastructure, training, and inference
  • Continuously improving our data and MLOps practices, and helping shape the roadmap for how our platform evolves as we scale

What you'll need

  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with a solid backend or data engineering foundation
  • Hands-on experience with containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and working with a major cloud provider
  • Experience building data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes at scale, including web scraping or automated data collection
  • A solid understanding of the ML lifecycle, from data through to model training, evaluation, and serving
  • Experience with data quality practices (validation, cleaning, normalisation) and/or production-grade observability
  • Ability to design resilient, scalable architectures, and comfort operating and troubleshooting distributed systems
  • MLOps experience, for example model serving, experiment tracking, GPU/distributed training optimisation, or reproducible ML workflows
  • A self-starter mentality: comfortable identifying problems and driving fixes without needing detailed direction

We encourage you to apply even if you do not feel you match all of the requirements exactly. The list of requirements is intended to show the kinds of experience and qualities we’re looking for, but it is not exhaustive. If you are interested in the role, the team, and our mission, we would love to consider your application. We are always open to conversations and look forward to hearing from you.

Who we are:

Speechmatics is the leading expert in Speech Intelligence, and uses AI and Machine Learning to unlock business value in human speech worldwide. We work with an amazing mix of global companies, and our technology can integrate into our customers stack irrespective of their industry or use case – making it the go-to solution to harness useful information from speech.

Joining us means working with some of the smartest minds around the world, focused on cutting-edge projects and deploying the latest techniques to disrupt the market. We believe in putting people first; we’ll do all we can to help you develop your skills and give you the tools you need to thrive. Our Focus Fridays give you an undisturbed day of focus, offset with Together Tuesdays when we have our team meetings, so you've always got the right balance.

We have structured a hybrid approach that includes 2-3 designated office days each week. This arrangement ensures that while we embrace the advantages of remote work, we also maintain the vital connection and synergy that only in-person interactions can foster.

This is only the beginning; we’re looking for amazing people like you to continue our journey…

What we can offer you:

No matter what stage of your career you’re at - from paid internships and first-job opportunities through to management and senior positions - we’ll support you with the training and development needed to reach your career aspirations with us. There really is no shortage of opportunities here for you to get involved and collaborate with those around you to deliver your best work.

We offer incredibly flexible working, regular company lunches, and birthday celebrations. But that’s not all. We’ve spoken to our teams to find out what they want. From Private Medical, and Dental for you and your family, through to global working opportunities, a generous holiday allowance and pension/401K matching, we want to make sure our employees and their families are looked after. Every employee will receive a working from home allowance for tech or home office equipment (on top of your choice of laptop and accessories of course). Our approach to parental leave is designed to support employees globally. While this varies by geo, we have support in place for parents (including adoption assistance and reproductive health services) to ensure they have the time and financial resources needed to care for their growing families.

At Speechmatics, our mission is simple: Understand Every Voice out there. 

That's not just about our tech – it's the heart and soul of who we are. We welcome different experiences, viewpoints, and identities. For us, it’s not just the right thing to do; it’s our catalyst for sparking innovation and creativity. Our teams thrive in an environment that celebrates and supports everyone – no matter their gender, identity or expression, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, religion, belief, marital status, national origin, veteran status, pregnancy, or maternity status.

But we don’t just open the door to diversity – we actively welcome it. Why? Because we believe every unique voice adds something special to our team, leading us to smarter solutions and a better workplace.

So, come as you are and join our Speechling community. We’re building a place where every voice not only gets heard but is also respected and valued.

For more information on us, please visit our website and follow Speechmatics on our social channels via Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

 

WHO WE ARE

About Data & Technology Solutions

WPP’s Data & Technology Solutions is the WPP’s unified global data products and technology team. We work with our agencies and clients to build data data-driven solutions and technology product to power marketing transformation.

WPP Open is our AI platform for marketing, it connects marketing professionals, data, tools and AI in a single place. WPP Open is the simplest, safest and fastest way to realize the benefits of scaled AI – delivering better-informed creative ideas faster, at scale and at lower cost.

We’re endlessly curious and our team of thinkers, builders, creators and problem solvers are over 2,000 strong, across 20 markets around the world.

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are seeking an enthusiastic and analytical Product Owner with a passion for leveraging data to build impactful products. In this role, you will support the product development lifecycle for our data-driven marketing solutions, including the WPP Open platform. You'll be instrumental in translating user needs and data insights into clear product requirements, ensuring our solutions are innovative, valuable, and technically sound. Your strong understanding of data and SQL will be key to communicating effectively with engineering and data science teams and making informed product decisions.

You are:

  • Data-curious, with a proven ability to analyze information and derive actionable insights.
  • Analytical and detail-oriented, capable of breaking down complex problems and defining clear product needs.
  • An excellent communicator, able to bridge the gap between technical and business stakeholders.
  • A proactive learner, eager to deepen your understanding of AdTech, product management, and data-driven methodologies.
  • Collaborative, thriving in a cross-functional team environment and contributing to a shared vision.

  • Support Product Development & Lifecycle Management

  • Help manage and refine product backlogs, participate in agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews), and support release cycles.
  • Conduct competitive analysis and market research to identify opportunities and stay informed about industry trends in data and AI for marketing.

 

Leverage Data for Product Insights and Validation

  • Utilize SQL and other data analysis tools to query datasets, analyze product performance, identify trends, and generate insights that inform product strategy and prioritization.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to understand data availability, schemas, quality, and potential for new product features or enhancements.
  • Define and track key product performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics, helping to evaluate the success of new features post-launch.
  • Help ensure data quality and integrity within product features, flagging discrepancies or potential issues.

 

Facilitate Stakeholder Communication & Feedback

  • Communicate product updates, release notes, and progress to various internal stakeholders, effectively highlighting the data-driven rationale behind product decisions.
  • Gather feedback from users, internal teams (e.g., commercial, operations), and clients to continuously iterate and improve our products.
  • Support in preparing presentations and documentation to articulate product vision, strategy, and roadmap.

 

Continuous Learning & Contribution

  • Actively seek to deepen your understanding of AdTech data, our internal platforms (including WPP Open), and user behaviors through self-study and mentorship.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of product management processes and tools within the team.

 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 0-2 years of experience in a product, business analyst, data analyst, or similar role with exposure to software development.
  • Proficiency in SQL is essential, with the ability to write complex queries to extract, analyze, and manipulate data from various sources.
  • Solid understanding of relational databases and data warehousing concepts.
  • English fluency C2
  • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI) is a strong plus.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and the software development lifecycle.
  • Ability to define and document clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable product insights.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to articulate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and vice-versa.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Marketing, Economics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.

Onze producten zijn wereldwijd te vinden in miljoenen woningen en commerciële gebouwen. Wij zijn op zoek naar gedreven, intelligente, creatieve en ondernemende mensen. Door uitdagende functies en versnelde groeimogelijkheden te bieden, gedreven door een gezamenlijke ambitie om succesvol te zijn, creëren wij een omgeving waarin uw carrière zich verder kan ontwikkelen.

In ruil voor uw expertise bieden wij een competitief en uitgebreid arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket, zodat u zich gewaardeerd voelt voor de bijdrage die u levert. Onze ambitie is om het snelst groeiende en meest geliefde raamdecoratiebedrijf ter wereld te worden. Wat is uw ambitie?

Product Manager Fabrics 

 

Wil jij werken op het snijvlak van productontwikkeling, commercie en innovatie binnen raamdecoratie? En krijg je energie van het ontwikkelen van producten die wereldwijd zichtbaar zijn? Dan is dit jouw kans om als Product Manager Fabrics impact te maken binnen ons internationale Product Team.

 

Jouw rol

Als Product Manager Fabrics ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en beheren van onze stofcollecties voor raamdecoratie. Van het eerste idee tot de introductie in de markt en uiteindelijk de doorontwikkeling of uitfasering: jij houdt het overzicht en zorgt dat de juiste mensen op het juiste moment in beweging komen.

Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met collega's uit onder andere Design, Sales, Marketing, R&D, Procurement, Operations en Manufacturing. Je vertaalt markt- en klantinzichten naar concrete productoplossingen en zorgt dat nieuwe collecties succesvol hun weg vinden naar de Europese markt.

 

Een veelzijdige rol dus, waarin productmanagement, projectmanagement, commercieel inzicht en data-analyse samenkomen.

 

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je beheert het fabrics-portfolio, daarbij zorg je voor correcte productspecificaties, productdata en documentatie gedurende de volledige productlevenscyclus.
  • Je leidt productontwikkelingsprojecten van concept tot marktintroductie.
  • Je brengt verschillende disciplines en stakeholders bij elkaar en bewaakt planning, voortgang, risico's en resultaten.
  • Je analyseert markt-, klant- en verkoopdata en vertaalt inzichten naar kansen voor het portfolio.
  • Je werkt mee aan productpositionering, prijsbeslissingen en businesscases.
  • Je ondersteunt Sales en Marketing met producttrainingen, presentaties en marktintroducties.
  • Samen met Design vertaal je marktinzichten naar commerciële uitgangspunten voor nieuwe collecties.
  • Je fungeert als productexpert voor interne en externe stakeholders en vertaalt complexe productinformatie naar duidelijke adviezen en oplossingen.
  • Je zorgt samen met Supply Chain en Operations voor een soepele introductie van nieuwe producten en een betrouwbare productbeschikbaarheid.

 

Dit breng jij mee

Je bent een ervaren en zelfstandige professional die graag structuur brengt in complexe projecten en energie krijgt van samenwerken met verschillende disciplines.

 

Voor deze positie zoeken we iemand met minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in bijvoorbeeld productmanagement, projectmanagement, category management of een vergelijkbare rol.

 

Daarnaast heb je:

  • Een hbo diploma in bijvoorbeeld Bedrijfskunde, Marketing, Textieltechnologie of een vergelijkbare richting.
  • Sterke projectmanagement- en stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden.
  • Commercieel inzicht en een klantgerichte blik.
  • Een analytische, data-gedreven manier van werken.
  • Ervaring met het werken aan meerdere projecten en met verschillende stakeholders tegelijk.
  • Goede beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels. Duits of een andere extra taal is een pré.
  • Interesse in AI en de manier waarop AI kan bijdragen aan productiviteit, inzichten en bedrijfsprocessen.

 

Je bent proactief, georganiseerd en hands-on. Je houdt overzicht wanneer er veel tegelijk gebeurt, neemt eigenaarschap en bent niet bang om zelf de handen uit de mouwen te steken.

 

Waarom deze rol?

Je komt terecht bij Artex in Aarle-Rixtel, maar bent deel van het Product Team van Hunter Douglas met hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam. Hunter Douglas is een wereldwijd toonaangevende speler in raamdecoratie en architecturale producten, met meer dan 100 jaar ervaring in innovatie.

 

In deze rol als Product Manager Fabrics werk je aan innovatieve stofoplossingen voor toonaangevende merken in raamdecoratie (zoals Luxaflex) en werk je samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines en landen. Je krijgt daarmee een brede rol met zichtbare impact op ons productportfolio én onze klantpropositie.

 

Klaar om jouw ervaring in te zetten voor producten die wereldwijd impact maken? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

 

Door hieronder je sollicitatie in te dienen, geef je vooraf toestemming om sms-berichten te ontvangen om je op de hoogte te stellen van updates over de status van je sollicitatie en om gedurende je sollicitatieproces met je in gesprek te gaan. Je kunt de sms-service op elk moment annuleren. Stuur gewoon “STOP” als antwoord op een van onze sms-berichten om je af te melden. Er kunnen kosten voor berichten en data van toepassing zijn. De frequentie van berichten kan variëren. We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential. When a drone fails a test on our production floor, you're the first person we call. As Production Quality Control Specialist (Software/Electronics), you're the first line of technical support for production. You troubleshoot, diagnose and fix failures across our VTOL drones, their sub-systems, sensors and in-process quality tests. That way every aircraft we ship meets the standard our customers rely on in the field. You also step back from single failures and look at the data. You analyze yields and quarantine trends, find the root causes behind repeat problems and decide which fixes to tackle first. You work closely with Production, Engineering and Supply Chain, and your work shows up directly in product quality and output. Responsibilities First on the scene. You're the first-line technical support for production issues, from test failures and assembly defects to nonconforming units. Fix what's broken. You troubleshoot and repair electrical, electronic and system-level failures on drones, sub-assemblies, payloads and sensors. Keep the test benches honest. You help investigate issues with our software and electronics test benches. Decide what happens to quarantined material. You choose whether it gets reworked, repaired, scrapped or returned to the supplier. Find the real cause. You lead root cause analyses (5 Whys, Ishikawa, 8D) on recurring and high-impact failures. Let the data point the way. You analyze yields and quarantine Paretos to spot the biggest quality drivers. See fixes through. You turn your findings into prioritized corrective actions (CAPA) and follow them until they are closed. Keep failure, test and repair records traceable. Share what you learn. You feed findings back to Engineering and suppliers, and you train assembly staff on failure modes and workmanship defects. You're motivated and able to get to know our test software stack. You're methodical and keep good records, and you make sound calls under production pressure. You have a technical apprenticeship or technical diploma in Engineering, Manufacturing or Mechatronics, or equivalent practical experience. You communicate excellently in English and enjoy working together on the shop floor. Plus Experience with UAVs, RC aircraft or avionics Familiarity with batteries, GNSS, IMUs, cameras or LiDAR Experience designing electronics PCBAs Experience in software programming SPC, Cp/Cpk, MSA or a Six Sigma Green Belt Python, SQL, BI or AI tools for data analysis Experience with non-conformance tracking, quality management systems or manufacturing ERP/PLM software Familiarity with inspection tools, measurement equipment, technical drawings and CAD Hands-on work with assembly line operators, manufacturing engineers and quality teams Continuous improvement methods such as 8D, 5S and CAPA Speaking or understanding German Joining Wingtra, you gain deep insight into applied robotics and aerial photogrammetry. description: Functie Reliability engineer Beschrijving functie De reliability engineer is een productie specialist die de totale levensduur van installatie bestudeert en analyseert hoe het bedrijf omgaat met investeringen en onderhoud van assets. De reliability engineer is de expert in het identificeren van potentiële risico’s en het voorkomen van stilstanden. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden. De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Ter voorkoming van stilstand maakt de reliability engineer onderhoudsschema’s en analyseert statistische gegevens die helpen te voorspellen wanneer en hoe fouten voor kunnen komen. De reliability engineer ontwikkelt inspectie criteria die gebruikt worden om de asset health te monitoren. Om dit te kunnen bereiken maakt de reliability engineer gebruik van een aantal technieken. Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn. Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf. Onderhoudbaarheid: gedetailleerde informatie hoe efficiënt en betrouwbaar het bedrijf een onderdeel kan repareren. Vanuit procurement komen verzoeken op het gebied van grondstof wijzigingen ( andere leverancier, andere specificaties ed.) Investeringsprojecten Participeren in investeringsprojecten om de onderhoudbaarheid te borgen en het inregelen van onderhoud en spare parts. Inbrengen van technische kennis en ervaringen. Toezien op naleving van de standaard op gebied van onderdelen en installaties. As a Customer Success Architect, you’ll sit at the intersection of business outcomes and technical excellence, helping customers align GitLab’s DevSecOps platform with their strategic goals.   • Program manage account escalations, ensuring timely coordination, communication, and resolution across GitLab teams and customer stakeholders.
  • Stay current on GitLab releases and new features, and proactively provide insights and recommendations on how customers can use them to achieve their objectives.

  • Ability to act as a trusted advisor to technical and business stakeholders, partnering with customers to define, prioritize, and achieve their desired outcomes.
  • Strong communication skills, including clear written and verbal communication, effective presentations, and the ability to explain technical topics to varied audiences.
  • Demonstrated project management capabilities, including organizing work, managing escalations, and coordinating across internal teams such as Support, Product Management, Sales, and Services.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills to interpret customer data, identify risks or opportunities, and recommend actionable next steps.
  • Comfort working both independently and as part of a distributed team, with attention to detail and alignment to GitLab’s values.
  • Openness to travel as needed and to apply transferable skills from related roles or industries in support of customer success and technical enablement.
